notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1] Tactical view [/h1]
We have implemented a first version of the tactical view. Activate it to have a better understanding of the game board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883961/11112c9367bd5a976d384f1822ab2458efb5b74a.png[/img]

[h1] Monthly reward [/h1]
Now, on your first login of each month, if you have played 10 or more Ranked matches in the past month, you will receive a reward.

The reward is based on your best ranking from the past month and calculated as follows: This is a rounding of ranking points divided by 50 with a minimum set of 10.

This system will allow players to be able to unlock some skins by playing rather than paying, depending on their skill.

[h1] Improvement of the global chat [/h1]
The game chat has been completely revised and now has a global lounge per game language as well as a private lounge to contact moderators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883961/87ab6a97d5ece84e9c2b2899f30ccd7a710bc4a3.png[/img]

[h1] Team creation screen [/h1]
Slightly improved the structure of the team building scene. In addition, an animation is triggered to indicate the last 10 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883961/c982ace1efa78e258a78e810f5ad647901748c47.png[/img]

[h1] A new illustration [/h1]
Here is finally the illustration of Ungo! A young dragon who likes to fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883961/2acb5a282c870c233807f49932065f6c8d417818.jpg[/img]

[h1] Tactical point indicator [/h1]
The total of tactical points possessed is displayed in the collection and selection of the game mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883961/f6d3bea90c63b2162245b82776d99c5052d16ff3.png[/img]

[h1] Balancing [/h1]
[list]
[*] Alog → Nerf: damage increase per charge decreased from 80 to 50;
[*] Movement skills: All movement skills no longer make the user visible if they are stealthed, even if they deal damage.
[/list]

[h1] Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrections of various texts;
[*] Added store button audio;
[*] Revision of the notification system;
[*] Names with quotes no longer crash the Leaderboard display;
[*] The game history correctly loads player nicknames and icons;
[*] The Epotykias trump summon icon now appears in the correct list;
[*] AI no longer casts Meline's "Target" spell in the void.
[/list]

notes.title: Update & Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a difficult month, we are back on the development of Lostria! Here is a small patch related to some of your feedback.

[h1]Update main content[/h1]

[h2]Global Chatroom[/h2]
We added a global chatroom. This is currently a really fast made one to help players to find opponents and organize themself to play together inside the game.

[h2]Feedback panel improvement[/h2]
We slightly upgraded the feedback panel to make it more clear for the users and we added the possibility to add your email if you need an answer.

[h2]Screen Resolution[/h2]
we added new resolutions in the settings :
[list]
[*] 2560x1440
[*] 3200x1800
[*] 3840x2160
[/list]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
Since our crowdfunding didn't work, we'll have to work with our own fund, making the development slower... We'll try to do our best to complete the first version as soon as possible.

Here are some points we'll try to do before the end of the year :
[list]
[*] Monthly ranked rewards (starting next month)
[*] Complete the maximum 3D characters (10 are currently missing for the minimal version)
[*] Adding a feature to let Twitch Chat play in custom games.
[*] Improving map Editor
[*] Tactical Mode (replace model by "tokens" to have a clear vision of the game)
[*] Adding VFX and SFX
[*] Improving musics
[*] Improving gameplay
[/list]
